_comment: Input to scripts/eligibility_litigation_worklist.py --extra: 5-in-5 suits the College Sports Litigation Tracker lists in its Class-of-2022 index but has no filings for, with the men's basketball plaintiffs as reported in the press. Not loaded by anything; `cstat-ingest returns` reads only {year}_returns.json.

Wells v. NCAA.court: Jefferson Circuit Court (Kentucky), Judge Brian Edwards
Wells v. NCAA.latest: Temporary restraining order granted to all thirteen plaintiffs, opening the Transfer Portal to them for one week (8/21/2026)

Okpara v. NCAA.latest: Fifty-plus-plaintiff suit voluntarily dismissed without prejudice after the NCAA moved to stay it as overlapping Wisne; the Texas Tech plaintiffs refiled in Lubbock County

Atwell v. NCAA.court: Lubbock County District Court (Texas), Judge John Grace
Atwell v. NCAA.latest: Temporary restraining order granted (8/31/2026); temporary injunction hearing moved from 9/11 to 10/15/2026. Darrion Williams is reported to hold a Texas TRO of his own on the same claim.
